title: International National Diploma in Education and Training Level 4
description: Empower expertise in education and training with a focus on instructional design, learner engagement, and leadership skills for effective knowledge delivery.
longDescription: The Undergraduate Level 4 Diploma in education and training is a 120 credit course designed to fast-track students to the final year of an associated Undergraduate B.A (Hons) endorsed in education and training, which can either be completed on campus or via distance learning. The course is made up of 6 units of Level 4 modules (120 credits). The endorsed Diploma in education and training (Level 4) provides a solid foundation in Principles of Education and Training (20 credits), Design Education and Training Provision (20 credits), Engage Learners in Education and Training (20 credits), Plan, Allocate and Monitor Work in Own Area of Responsibility (20 credits), Professional Development and Reflection in Education and Training (20 credits), and Evaluate Education and Training Provision (20 credits). It emphasizes academic rigor, critical thinking, and effective research methods.
courseDetails: Each module consists of 40 guided learning hours of material with an additional 30-50 hours worth of optional materials which comprise of recommended exercises, recommended readings and internet resources. Within the modules are self-testing exercises. You must take care in answering these. Although they are not marked nor do they count towards your final assessment, the marking is tested against your scoring on the final assessment to check for consistency of score. Successful completion of the full Level 4 endorsed Diploma in education and training will give students the right credentials to go on and apply for a job in education and training, human resources, management or business consultancy.

entry: For entry into Level 4 Diploma in Eduaction and Training, learners must possess the following:
* Relevant/Local Board of Examination Result in your Country, which must include at least 5 'C' Grades in English and 4 other subjects.
* Mock Examination Result can also be accepted for initial Conditional Admission, pending the release of the Board of Examination Result. (This is assessed on a case by case basis)
* Learner must be 18 years or older at the start of the Course.
* Mature Learners (21 years or older) with work experience in supervisory, leadership or management roles. (This is assessed on a case by case basis).
accreditation: All GSS courses are accredited by the relevant partners and awarding bodies. Please refer to GSS accreditation in about us for more details.
workshops: Workshops are conducted by live webinars for online students. Classroom workshops are available if there is a local branch in your country. Speak our course advisors on this subject.
visa: There is no Visa requirement for this programme.
gettingStartedIntro: Complete the application, document review, offer, payment and enrolment steps through the learner portal.
